content: ClipMate 主稿（PH 版）：Your clipboard, finally searchable. ClipMate keeps every text, link, and snippet you copy on Windows — searchable for the last 3 months, stored locally, never uploaded. OCR extracts text from screenshots; paste-as-plain-text cleans code formatting. Free + Pro $8/mo.
notes: 中文社区版本需要开发背景花絮（一人两年独立开发）；X 需 thread 两条
